newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - February 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - February 14.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Communist China involved in investigation of U.S. political contribution.
Three more professional baseball players released on bail after being questioned for game-fixing.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Hsiao Teng-shih, prominent figure in southern Chiayi county, to be questioned for alleged involvement in professional baseball scandal.
Prosecutors and police launch overall crackdown on gangsters' influence in local farmers' credit union elections.
LIBERTY TIMES - Nationalist Party to approve constitutional reform items on May 3.
Competition intensifies between ruling and opposition parties over Taoyuan county by-election.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Worldwide stock markets rise as technology shares lead gains.
Taiwan to hold WTO task force meeting on February 28.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Taiwan share prices breach 7,500-point as bull run continues.
Local insurance firms bid for fourth nuclear power plant's T$80 billion insurance.
